d.ko:
The title of “fastest” never fades.
Race through the sealed future Tokyo night highways in your customized car.
Defeat rivals in “SP Battle,” where drivers clash by draining Spirit Points.
A unique racing game where only the rules for victory matter.

d.zh:
即使时代变迁，“最快”的称号依然不会褪色。
驾驶你亲手定制的爱车，在被封锁的未来东京夜间高速公路上飞驰。
在削减对手精神力的「SP对战」中击败众多对手。
这是一款“只遵守胜利规则”的独一无二竞速游戏。
